topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: It's such a gentle surprise, isn't it? To find out someone who understands the twists of your thoughts, the quiet nooks of your heart, lives just a few streets away. I keep thinking about the way the sun must shine on the path between our homes, how the wind might carry whispers of home to where you are. Maybe, just maybe, we could walk that path together, see where it leads. Not rush into anything, just enjoy the quiet companionship, the shared breath of the world around us. It feels like the kind of day where everything could be just right.
